name: manual_577328
claim: Dry-run before long-running or cross-repo execution: for long-running goals, autonomous loops, plugin installs, GPU work, external LLM usage, or cross-repo changes — run/produce a dry-run plan first showing affected files and commands, classify risks and ownership, avoid side effects until reviewed. Dry-run must not call paid/external LLMs, install plugins, touch GPUs, mutate AlphaClaw, or mutate repos beyond a plan/report file.

decisions.notes: Recorded 2026-07-04 planning session. Prevents irreversible side effects from autonomous agent actions.
